Measure each source loaded at coordinator session start in C:/KenshiModding: root CLAUDE.md; the output of tools/automation/session-start.ps1 -Brief (run it once, record bytes and lines); the auto-memory MEMORY.md index and the files it links; the hook-injected blocks (context-meter, open alerts, process ideas). For each source give bytes, lines and the five largest sections with line ranges. Then list which sections repeat across sources. Save the report with save-report.ps1 (agents/out/startup-context-measure-1) and report the path. Keep the status file current with tools/automation/agent-status.ps1 startup-context-measure-1 RUNNING/DONE/FAILED. Goal: a ranked list of what can move out of startup context without losing a standing rule; do not propose rule deletions, only moves to a page the rule index names.
decision.why: The cut needs real byte counts before any file is edited, and a reader is the cheapest way to get them.
